actions.name: sync_client_get_state
actions.description: Report this client's sync state: last successful sync, pending changes and connection status. Read-only.

version.description: Store version the local mirror is caught up to.

state.description: Mirrored key → value map from the host sync store.

config_schema.description: Client-side mirror of the host `sync` plugin: subscribes to its delta events (`plugin.sync.sync.delta`), seeds from `sync_get_snapshot` on (re)connect, and writes a `heartbeat.<device_id>` key via `sync_set` on a timer.

SYNC_CLIENT_HEARTBEAT_SECS.description: Heartbeat interval in seconds; 0 disables the heartbeat task.

SYNC_CLIENT_DEVICE_ID.description: Device id used in the heartbeat key (`heartbeat.<device_id>`). Defaults to the HOSTNAME env var, then "local".

SYNC_CLIENT_SNAPSHOT_TIMEOUT_MS.description: Timeout for the sync_get_snapshot pull at (re)connect.
